keyEvents.text: Jesús Lara (León) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Emmanuel Echeverría (Santos Laguna).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Delay in match because of an injury Carlos Acevedo (Santos Laguna).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Own Goal by Emmanuel Echeverría, Santos Laguna. Santos Laguna 0, León 1.
Kevin Palacios (Santos Laguna) is shown the red card.
Luis Valadez (León) is shown the yellow card.
First Half ends, Santos Laguna 0, León 1.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Aldo López replaces Emmanuel Echeverría.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Ramiro Sordo replaces Fran Villalba.
Substitution, León. Sebastián Fierro replaces Luis Valadez.
Second Half begins Santos Laguna 0, León 1.
Substitution, León. Jordi Cortizo replaces Jesús Lara.
Goal! Santos Laguna 1, León 1. Ramiro Sordo (Santos Laguna) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, León. Juan Domínguez replaces Rodrigo Echeverría.
Substitution, León. Ismael Díaz replaces Sebastián Vegas.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Esteban Lozano replaces Tahiel Jiménez.
Substitution, León. Alfonso Alvarado replaces Fernando Beltrán.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Eduardo Aguirre replaces Ezequiel Bullaude.
Substitution, Santos Laguna. Salvador Mariscal replaces Facundo Cáseres.
Goal! Santos Laguna 1, León 2. Ismael Díaz (León) right footed shot from outside the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Daniel Arcila.
Second Half ends, Santos Laguna 1, León 2.
